text:
Landed as candidate 4383a85 on m1/resolution. Gate: recall 41 on JVM, JS AND Native (each run and each confirmed separately - the combined run's filtered log showed only one platform's Passed line, so I re-ran JS and Native explicitly rather than report a cross-platform gate I had not actually seen); align 177, fixtures 110, interview 81, laws 81; scalafmtCheckAll clean, run as the last action before commit.

WHAT IT DOES: RecallGraph.validated now requires a unit's text to be the transcript at its span hull. Before this, a unit could hold the span for "First thing happened." and the text "THE GHOSTS WERE ANGRY" and validate clean.

WHY THE HULL, NOT PER-REF SLICES: a unit whose support is discontinuous - spanning two sentences - legitimately carries the material in the gap between them. Concatenating per-ref slices would reject that. There is a test asserting the accepted text IS the hull slice, so a later change to concatenation fails loudly rather than silently narrowing what a multi-sentence unit may say.

MOVEMENT: none. No currently-passing input changes behaviour; I measured that before writing the code rather than discovering it after. That is the argument for doing it now - the invariant already holds everywhere, so enforcing it is free TODAY and stops being free once the cell-trace function and its callers exist.

MUTATIONS KILLED: (1) drop the law - two tests fail. (2) drop the out-of-range guard - two tests throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of returning a typed refusal. That second one is the non-obvious half: `validated` accumulates rather than short-circuits, so the text check still runs on a graph whose span check has already failed, and without the guard the caller gets an exception where it asked for a Validated. One of the two tests it breaks is PRE-EXISTING, so the guard protects behaviour that was already promised, not just my new law.

I also added a test pinning that trailing whitespace is still a mismatch. Not pedantry: trimming is the exact relaxation someone will reach for the first time this law fails on real segmenter output, and it would reopen the hole by letting the trace quote text that is not in the transcript.

Ruling that produced this bead: post-01M16KFZHZAACFWXTM3XCQS6N6. Proposals B (semantic imputation) and C (the cell trace itself) from that ruling are NOT in this commit - B is a contract change to ADR 0001's cost model and is the chief's to rule, and C depends on B.

Pending chief gate on m1/resolution, in order: c1049f2, e538a09, 2adfff2, aee72ed, 4383a85.
